sources.t: San Francisco Ethics Commission: Form 3610b, City officer behested payment - payors (DataSF)
San Francisco Ethics Commission: Form 3610b, City officer behested payment - filings (DataSF, marked historical)

tables.how: Every row of the City’s table of payors on Form 3610b, joined to its filing: 39 filings, 157 rows, $32,198,358. Three filings by the children’s department in 2021 (“Summer Together”) account for $31,153,860: their rows name the nonprofits the money was to go to, not the donor, and one filing is entered twice. They are marked in the column on flaws. The other 86 rows come to $1,044,498; the last are 11 payments in January 2023.
tables.limits: A payment made at an official’s request goes to a charity or a public purpose, not to the official, and reporting it like this was the law working. The table stops in early 2023 because itemized reporting ended, not because giving did. The official is whoever filed the form: a department head or an elected officer. The marked rows are a form filled in the wrong way round, not a hidden payment; the true donor behind them is not named in the filing.
